verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Termius can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA and ML-DSA keys, plus FIDO2 and biometric keys. It manages them with passphrase protection and offers an export of public keys to the server's authorized_keys file, which covers the password-less access workflow end to end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of key generation and export to authorized_keys.
